prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end square studio portrait using the approved adult person photo as the main subject. The clearly adult person stands smiling against a clean minimal background in soft neutral tones, wearing a black textured knit sweater and holding a large vertical poster in front of them. The poster features an artistic reinterpretation of the same approved adult face, stylized as a digital illustration, sketch, or painterly artwork, clearly recognizable as the same fictional creator identity. Use professional studio lighting with a soft approximately 5000K key light and subtle rim light to create gentle shadows and depth. The expression is calm and confident, posture relaxed yet strong, evoking a modern generic personal-brand identity. Keep the composition clean and balanced, with shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, crisp details, contemporary creator-branding energy, cinematic realism, and no real name, logo, or public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, public-figure name, real logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, mismatched face, poster text errors, distorted poster edges
